verifications.claim: Eid prayers are performed on Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Eid al-Fitr... Eid al-Adha'; R3: 'Eid al-Fitr... and Eid al-Adha'; similar in all others.
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in all references as the two Eids.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers are performed shortly after sunrise.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'after sunrise and before noon'; R2: 'fifteen minutes after sunrise'; R4: 'shortly after sunrise'; R3: 'early morning, after Fajr'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources specify timing shortly after sunrise.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers are typically performed in open spaces or mosques.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'open space (such as a Musalla or Eidgah) or field...'; R5: 'open space, like a large field, rather than in a mosque, though... at home'; R3: 'mosques hold several Eid prayers'.
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly mentions open spaces/Eidgah primarily, mosques also common.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers consist of two rak'ats.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'two rakats'; R1: 'each Rakat'; universal across sources.
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as two rak'ahs in all detailed procedure sources.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers include extra takbeers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'number of Takbir... performed in each Rakat'; all procedure sources detail extra takbirs.
verifications.reasoning: Defining feature of Eid prayer in every source.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers are followed by a khutbah.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'delivered after the Salah for Eid'; R5: 'listen to the Khutbah'; R6: 'Imam will likely give a khutbah (sermon) afterwards'.

verifications.claim: Muslim Hands UK and Islamic Relief Worldwide say it is Sunnah to perform ghusl before attending Eid prayers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9 (Muslim Hands): 'Sunnah to make ghusl'; R3 (Islamic Relief): 'perform ghusl... sunnah'; R7/R8 similar.
verifications.reasoning: Exact organizations cited explicitly state it as Sunnah.

verifications.claim: Muslim Hands UK and Islamic Relief Worldwide say it is Sunnah to wear fine clothes before attending Eid prayers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9: 'put on your best clothes'; R3: 'wear the best clothes you have'; context Sunnah.
verifications.reasoning: Directly from named sources in Sunnah preparation context.

verifications.claim: Muslim Hands UK and Islamic Relief Worldwide say it is Sunnah to eat before attending Eid prayers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'it’s sunnah to eat something'; R9: 'Sunnah to eat something before the prayer'; R8: 'sunnah to eat something'.
verifications.reasoning: Named sources state as Sunnah (for Fitr context).

verifications.claim: Eid prayer time is after sunrise and before Zuhr.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'after sunrise... before noon'; R2: 'after sunrise until zawal'; R7: 'after the sun has risen... before zawaal'.
verifications.reasoning: Zuhr aligns with noon/zawal; directly supported.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers are performed in congregation.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Muslims congregate'; R3: 'join in congregational prayer'; standard emphasis.

verifications.claim: In the first rak'ah of Eid prayer, 3 or 7 extra takbeers are recited after the opening takbeer depending on school of thought.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Hanafis complete 3 takbirs... Muhammad completed 7 takbirs in the first'; R11 details schools: 3 Hanafi, 7 Shafi'i.

verifications.claim: In the second rak'ah of Eid prayer, 3 or 5 extra takbeers are recited before ruku.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '5 in the second'; Hanafi 3; R11: 5 for several schools.

verifications.claim: Khutbah is delivered after Eid prayer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'delivered after the Salah'; consistent.

verifications.claim: It is Sunnah to recite the Takbeerat 'Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, La ilaha illallah...' while traveling to the Eid prayer location.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9: 'recite takbeer... Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar. La ilaaha illa-llaah'; R1: 'saying the Takbir to and from'; exact phrase.

verifications.claim: Eid prayer involves making niyyah to pray 2 raka’at Eid salah.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'set out your intentions for both rakats'; R9: 'make your niyyah (intention)... two raka’ah of the Eid'.
verifications.reasoning: Standard intention for 2 rak'ahs Eid salah.

verifications.claim: In the first rakah of Eid prayer, opening takbeer is 'Allahu Akbar' followed by 3–7 additional takbeers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '7 takbirs in the first... Hanafis 3'; R3: 'say 3 more takbir'.

verifications.claim: In the first rakah of Eid prayer, Surah Al-Fatiha and another Surah are recited loudly.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'recite Surah al-Fatiha loudly'; R5: 'recite Surah Al-Fatiha... loudly'.

verifications.claim: The first rakah of Eid prayer is completed with ruku and sajdah.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'say takbir once more while getting into ruku and completing'; standard procedure.

verifications.claim: In the second rakah of Eid prayer, it starts with 3–5 additional takbeers.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'recite takbir... five more times'; R3: 'give 3 additional takbir'; but after recitation in some.
verifications.reasoning: Takbirs in second rak'ah vary, not always 'starts with'; broader description.

verifications.claim: In the second rakah of Eid prayer, Al-Fatiha and another Surah are recited.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'listen to the imam recite Surah al-Fatihah and an additional surah' in second.

verifications.claim: The second rakah of Eid prayer is completed with ruku, sajdah, and final Tashahhud/Salam.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'complete your Eid prayer'; R5: 'Tashahhud... Salam'; standard.

verifications.claim: Eid prayers can be performed at home with family if one cannot attend a mosque.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'perform Eid prayer at home with Your Loved Ones'; R11: 'performed individually or with family at home'; R5: 'at home in a pinch'.
